scope.question: Does the immutable Phase-42 phi_plus Gamma-K candidate continue as one transverse nonlinear m=5 R18 cap candidate along the Phase-50 diagonal stabilized-action/SPD-metric path, with an independently initialized phi_minus reflection control?
computed: fine-forward, coarse-forward, and fine-reverse nonlinear Gamma-K continuation for phi_plus
one independently initialized fine-forward phi_minus reflection-control path
R18 residual, rank, transversality, orientation, path, and first-cap ledgers
full-J finite differences at lambda 0, 0.5, and 1 for phi_plus
one phi_plus path-tangent control at lambda 0.5
phi_plus lambda=1 radius and launch-shape controls
CSE clongdouble production evaluation with paired non-CSE clongdouble validation
not_computed: other sources, roots, charts, straight arms, or cap reintersections
direction, root, saddle, or upward-component exhaustion
Stokes data, all relative good ends, or a physical original cycle
a common physical determinant line, cutoff or continuum limit, global integer, or physics claim

disclosed_feasibility_pilot.backend: non-CSE NumPy clongdouble gradient/flow with DOP853 rtol=8e-11, atol=8e-13, max_step=0.025

arithmetic_backend_feasibility.role: pre-freeze feasibility observation used only to avoid an impossible paired-backend threshold; the frozen 2e-7 endpoint threshold is more than three times this observation and remains far below the 5e-5 same-candidate radius/shape bound

disclosed_feasibility_pilot.boundary: This pilot used neither production source, did not use the frozen CSE evaluator, observed no phi_plus endpoint, and supplies no target sign, threshold, or classification.

model_path.real_order: interleaved real and imaginary parts in complex_order
model_path.action: Exactly the pinned Phase-50 S_lambda=(1-lambda)*S4_lift+lambda*S5 with its positive-determinant common basis B, kappa_a=-140000, and kappa_phi=24000.
model_path.metric: Exactly the pinned Phase-50 primary affine-invariant SPD geodesic M_geo(mu), evaluated only on the diagonal mu=lambda.
model_path.saddles: Solve each source independently on lambda; require reproduction of the pinned Phase-50 saddle at every common mesh node. No reflected root may replace an independent solve.
model_path.factor: Let A0=B*blockdiag(L4,abs(kappa_a)^(-1/2),kappa_phi^(-1/2)), using the pinned Phase-42 L4 and Phase-50 B. Set A_lambda=M_lambda^(1/2)*M0^(-1/2)*A0 with principal SPD powers. Require A_lambda*A_lambda.T=M_lambda and exact return to A0 at lambda=0.
model_path.flow: With w=w_saddle+A_lambda*xi, integrate dot(xi)=-conjugate(A_lambda.T*gradient_w S_lambda(w)); lambda and source stay fixed on each trajectory and A.T is not Hermitian.

gamma_and_root_map.cap: Let d_a=P*(y_a1,y_a2,y_a3)+q*y_added_a and d_phi=P*(y_phi1,y_phi2,y_phi3)+q*y_added_phi using the pinned Phase-50 P and q. Then a_j=abar_j+exp(i*(psi/2-pi/2))*d_a[j], phi_j=phibar_j+exp(i*psi/2)*d_phi[j], and T=0.3*exp(i*psi).
gamma_and_root_map.scaled_residual: Realify D^(-1)*(Gamma5-K5) in the frozen real order, with D given by coordinate_scales.
gamma_and_root_map.Gamma_tangent: Use the six exact Phase-50 P columns, the two exact q added-mode columns, and d_psi a_j=(i/2)*(a_j-abar_j), d_psi phi_j=(i/2)*(phi_j-phibar_j), d_psi T=i*T.
gamma_and_root_map.K_tangent: Integrate eight real chart variations with dZ/dt=-conjugate((A_lambda.T*H(w)*A_lambda)*Z) and append the positive endpoint flow vector for flow_time.
gamma_and_root_map.direct_orientation: sign det_R[V_Gamma,V_K] after positive column normalization

launch_chart.signed_frame: At every node form H_xi=A_lambda.T*H_lambda*A_lambda, order its five-negative and four-positive real subspaces, align each signed block by determinant-aware orthogonal Procrustes transport, and recompute the signed restricted-Hessian launch shape.
launch_chart.shape: Apply the inverse positive square root of each absolute signed Hessian restriction raised to shape_exponent before its phase.
launch_chart.lambda0_launch: For each source augment its immutable Phase-42 primary J4 exactly by the added signed directions (-1,+i) in factor coordinates. The Phase-51 lambda=0 physical launch must replay A0*blockdiag(J4,-1,+i) to the frozen relative threshold.
launch_chart.chart: Freeze omega_center=(Phase42 center7,0,0) and C=[embedded Phase42 7x6 tangent,e_added_a,e_added_phi], so det[C,omega_center]=+1. Use omega(u)=normalize(omega_center+C*u) without recentering.
launch_chart.lambda0_seed: Copy the immutable Phase-42 six Gamma y, psi, six chart u, and flow_time; set eta_a=eta_phi=u_added_a=u_added_phi=0. The cap function applies P and q at evaluation time.

continuation.seed_rule: phi_plus fine and coarse start from separately solved lambda=0 lifts; its reverse starts only from its fine-forward lambda=1 root. phi_minus runs one independent fine-forward path from its own lambda=0 lift. Each forward node uses only its immediately preceding node.
continuation.matching: Compare normalized ambient cap states and determinant-corrected tangents at common nodes; raw chart coordinates are not invariant matching data.
continuation.fallback: No random restart, extra direction, reflected seed substitution, chart recentering, clipping, mesh insertion, or favorable solver/step replacement.

evaluator.symbolic_source: One SymPy S_lambda generates the nine-component holomorphic gradient and 9x9 Hessian.
evaluator.production: Run one deterministic sympy.cse(...,order='canonical') pass jointly over gradient and Hessian. Evaluate state formation, all CSE temporaries, gradient, Hessian action, A_lambda.T contraction, and outer conjugation in NumPy clongdouble; cast each complete RHS once to complex128 at solve_ivp.
evaluator.validation: Evaluate the unreduced non-CSE gradient and Hessian independently in clongdouble with no CSE replacement list or output cache.
evaluator.exact_check: Back-substitute the CSE replacements and require exact symbolic equality with every non-CSE gradient and Hessian expression.
evaluator.paired_reintegrations: Independently reintegrate the three phi_plus central trajectories at lambda 0, 0.5, and 1 with the non-CSE backend; validation may not replace a production root.
prohibited: using non-CSE output to select or repair production

damped_newton.implementation: custom deterministic Newton step np.linalg.lstsq(J,-R,rcond=None) with state-only residual-decrease line search
damped_newton.acceptance: The trial remains strictly inside the frozen parameter box and its state-only Euclidean residual norm is smaller than the current norm; otherwise continue the frozen halving sequence.

fixed_numerics.same_map: The CSE-clongdouble flow map used for production roots is also used for acceptance, path ledgers, variational tangents, and finite differences.

full_J_FD.rule: Retain both central-difference matrices for all eighteen columns; compare the larger-step matrix with the variational J and the two FD matrices with each other; no columnwise step selection.

path_tangent.implicit: At fixed central p, central-difference the complete residual in lambda including re-solved saddle, metric, frame, chart, and nonlinear flow, then solve dp/dlambda=-J^(-1)*dR/dlambda.
path_tangent.resolved: Independently solve roots at lambda plus/minus h and central-difference their consistently transported parameter vectors.
path_tangent.rule: Retain both steps, all four off-node roots, both tangent pairs, solve residuals, and adjacent-step metrics.

endpoint.radius_seed: Preserve the primary physical direction and shift time by log(primary_radius/control_radius).
endpoint.shape_seed: Map the primary physical direction by maximum positive overlap into the control shape.
endpoint.same_candidate: Require normalized cap-state match, transversality, corrected sign, path ledger, and first-cap ledger; sign alone is insufficient.

controls.reflection: At every fine node compare independently solved phi_minus with nodal reflection of phi_plus for saddle, action, cap state, transversality, and determinant-corrected sign.
controls.path: For every accepted primary/control path retain Re(S) monotonicity, Im(S) drift, xi norm, 101 samples, and an independent first-|T|=0.3 solve_ivp event check.

classification.supported_if: All provenance/platform checks and every target, reflection, mesh, reverse, derivative, evaluator, endpoint, path, boundary, rank, transversality, and orientation check pass.
classification.contradicted_required_independent_certif: A separately frozen interval, augmented-fold, or local-degree certificate; Phase 51 implements none.
classification.contradicted_if_certificate_existed: Only a certificate that independently resolves a transversality zero or frozen boundary/first-cap event could contradict this declared candidate/path.
classification.inconclusive_if: Any rank, determinant, boundary, cap, solver, mesh, derivative, evaluator, reflection, or endpoint check does not pass. Ordinary solver nonconvergence, seed loss, box exhaustion, or a small sampled singular value is never a no-root or contradiction certificate.

run_semantics.invalid_run: Input/hash/platform/CSE reconstruction/dtype/order/slot/global-null drift, undeclared fallback, or nonfinite JSON is INVALID_RUN.
run_semantics.scientific_failure: Every complete rank, determinant, boundary, cap, solver, mesh, derivative, evaluator, reflection, or endpoint non-pass is retained as INCONCLUSIVE because the required independent contradiction certificate is absent.
run_semantics.emission: Emit exactly one finite RESULT_JSON line on stdout; progress goes to stderr.
